# Vettic Labs

> Vettic Labs is a talent-matchmaking and recruiting service for founders and hiring managers. Senior recruiters run each search by hand and deliver vetted shortlists of 3–5 candidates, each scored on seven signals against a signed-off role brief, with a human's written reasoning next to every score. Every placement trains an explainable matching engine.

Site: https://vetticlabs.com/
Contact: founders@vetticlabs.com · +91 95328 08031
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/vetticlabs/

## What Vettic Labs delivers

- A candidate dossier, not a résumé folder: each candidate scored signal-by-signal against your brief (e.g. shipped 0→1 product, stage fit, comp alignment, founder references, domain depth, equity comfort, timezone overlap), with written reasons for every score.
- Shortlists of 3–5 candidates, never thirty.
- Candidate names stay redacted until both sides opt in.

## How a search runs

1. **Day 0 — The brief.** One intro call becomes a one-page role brief you sign off on (skills, stage, compensation band, timeline).
2. **Days 1–2 — Calibration.** Three sample profiles to react to, so disagreement happens early and cheaply.
3. **Days 3–5 — The shortlist.** Sourced and screened by hand; the scored dossier lands by day five.
4. **Day 14 — Signed.** Interviews, offer support, and reference notes through to a signed offer. Day 14 is the median designed for, not a guarantee.

## Terms

- **Fee:** success-fee only — a fixed percentage of first-year compensation, agreed before Day 0. No retainer, nothing up front.
- **Guarantee:** if a placement leaves inside 30 days, the search re-runs at no charge.
- **Never:** résumé floods, exclusivity handcuffs, black-box scores.

## The matching engine

Most AI recruiting tools rank résumés on keyword overlap and output unexplained confidence scores. Vettic runs the loop in reverse: humans score every signal by hand today, and every completed search becomes a labeled outcome (who got hired, whether they stuck) that trains an explainable matching engine. Any score the engine shows arrives with the same seven written reasons.

## For candidates

Candidates can join the vetted pool via the form on the site. A human reads every submission and reaches out only when a search genuinely fits — no flood of irrelevant pings.
